name: at interpolation wraps a loop and increments lap

steps.why: First fix is about 50 m along the first side of the loop.
This fix is about 100 m along the loop, a forward gain of 50 m in 10 s.
This fix is about 150 m along the loop, another forward gain of 50 m in 10 s.
This fix is about 200 m along the loop, another forward gain of 50 m in 10 s.
This fix is about 250 m along the loop, another forward gain of 50 m in 10 s.
This fix is about 300 m along the loop, another forward gain of 50 m in 10 s.
This fix is about 350 m along the loop, another forward gain of 50 m in 10 s.
This fix is about 398 m along the loop, a forward gain of 48 m in 10 s, below half the 400 m loop.
Speed is 4.8 m/s. One second adds 4.8 m to about 398 m; 402.8 wraps to about 3 m on lap 1.
